reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: SAFER: Strenthening Activism For Environmental Rights

description.narrative:
Overall objective of the project os to uphold and protect collective socio-economic and environmental rights by optimising the actions and safety of Indigenous Peoples and local communities (IPLCs) and grassroots civil society organisations (CSOs) while creating an enabling environment to promote use of rights-based and community-owned approaches for conservation, regeneration and management of natural resources in Sri Lanka and the Maldives

Specific objective(s):

Specific objective 1: To create and coach a network of socio-economic and environmental watchdogs to promote safe and optimised activism via mobilisation and empowerment of IPLCs;

Specific objective 2: To establish streamlined mechanisms and methods for community-led reporting on socio-economic and environmental rights violations and responses via improved access to digital and information and communication technologies (ICT)
